title: AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay

task.value: Mining alpha factors that predict future asset returns while resisting alpha decay caused by overfitting and factor crowding.
task.quote: we propose AlphaAgent, an autonomous framework that effectively integrates LLM-driven agents with ad hoc regularization for mining decay-resistant alpha factors.

architecture.value: Closed loop of three LLM agents: idea agent proposes market hypotheses, factor agent builds AST-based factor expressions under originality/alignment/complexity regularization with a knowledge base, eval agent backtests and feeds back. Factors plus base alphas feed a LightGBM model.
architecture.quote: AlphaAgent implements a recurrent framework for alpha factor mining through three specialized agents powered by large language models (LLMs): idea agent, factor agent, and eval agent.

data.value: Daily OHLCV data for CSI 500 (China A-shares, from Baostock) and S&P 500 (US, from Yahoo Finance).
data.quote: Raw data employed to construct alpha factors include only OHLCV (i.e., $open, $high, $low, $close, $volume). CSI 500 data is collected from Baostock (BaoStock, 2024), while S&P 500 data is from Yahoo Finance (Aroussi, 2024).

window.value: Training 2015-01 to 2019-12, validation 2020-01 to 2020-12, testing 2021-01 to 2025-01 (1004 trading days S&P 500; 968 CSI 500).

models.value: GPT-3.5-turbo as base LLM for agents; LightGBM (max depth 4) forecaster; also tested Qwen-Plus and DeepSeek-R1 as base LLMs.
models.quote: AlphaAgent employs GPT-3.5-turbo (Ouyang et al., 2022) as the foundational LLM to support agents.

baselines.value: LSTM, Transformer, LightGBM, StockMixer, TRA, AlphaForge, RD-Agent (GPT-4-turbo), OpenAI-o1 and DeepSeek-R1 (best-of-10); also Alpha158, GP and RSI for decay analysis.
baselines.quote: We compare AlphaAgent with several baseline approaches: (1) Traditional time-series forecasting models including LSTM (Graves and Graves, 2012) and Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) which capture temporal dependencies; (2) Tree-based model LightGBM

costs.value: CSI 500: 0.0005 buying and 0.0015 selling fees; S&P 500: only selling fee of 0.0005. Top-50 dropout-5 strategy.
costs.quote: For CSI 500, the transaction fees are set at 0.0005 for buying and 0.0015 for selling. For S&P 500, only selling fees are applied, with a rate of 0.0005.

uncertainty.value: 20 independent trials of five rounds for RD-Agent and AlphaAgent; Student's t test on IC differences vs RD-Agent with p-values below 0.05 (0.0311, 0.0109, 0.0382) across base LLMs.
uncertainty.quote: with p-values for IC differences between AlphaAgent and RD-Agent being consistently below 0.05 (GPT-3.5-turbo: 0.0311, Qwen-Plus: 0.0109, DeepSeek-R1: 0.0382).
